posts.post:
wearing a hoodie to a business meeting. 

acceptable in 2024 or just lazy?

most people think a tailored fit means tight. 

it’s actually just about where the fabric decides to hang.

there is nothing more exhausting than a zipper that catches right at the waistline. 

we spent three days just selecting the right gauge to avoid this.
nothing hits quite like walking into a room knowing your outfit is the quietest thing in there.
